purpose: Transparent ranked candidates and gene-product annotation; descriptive context for regional RNA and spatial reference visualization.
audience: Bilingual scientific website and downloadable research figures; no journal submission specification asserted.
source_DE: Unchanged primary regional results; cortex author20 reanalysis is not the ranking input.
ranking: BH q then source gene symbol; finite MLE, SE and shrunken coefficient required for measured-panel lists.
interval: Pointwise normal approximation: MLE log2FC ± 1.959963984540054 * original lfcSE. Not simultaneous or selection-adjusted; diamonds show separate shrunken coefficients.

atlas_mapping.hypothalamus: Exact original source symbol against MERFISH panel; source matrix does not provide original Ensembl IDs. Official current aliases are displayed separately.
atlas_mapping.cortex: Exact source Ensembl gene ID against MERFISH panel; source IDs retained.

annotation_identity: Current exact NCBI mouse symbol preferred; unique official alias explicitly disclosed. UniProt exact primary mouse gene name preferred to historical synonyms; only unique reviewed records assigned.
functional_group_semantics: Descriptive manual summaries from linked official records; not enrichment, pathway activation, cell identity, protein quantification or exposure-specific mechanism.
cautions: All primary hypothalamic coding hits decrease; both increases are noncoding or pseudogene signals under current annotation.
Nine of ten measured hypothalamic candidates are exploratory (q≥0.05); six show strong coefficient shrinkage.
All11 hypothalamic primary hits retain direction in7of7 leave-one-animal-out runs, but none retains q<0.05 in all7.
Cortex sex/identity metadata require verification; this study-level flag does not mean that every selected gene is sex-linked.
Regional RNA does not resolve cell composition, protein abundance, enzyme activity or transcript isoforms.
Ak4 mouse functional annotation is by similarity to human AK4; reviewed human annotation records conflicting in-vitro catalytic findings.
Ksr2 is interpreted as a scaffold; very low in-vitro kinase activity in reviewed annotation does not establish active catalysis in these data.
rebuild: ./.venv-analysis/bin/python scripts/analyze_gene_priorities.py; use --refresh-annotations only to change the frozen annotation snapshot.
